title: Junior data analyst (SQL / Excel / Tableau)
description: A junior analyst with ~1.5 years of SQL/Excel/Tableau experience evaluated against 8 postings: one strong analyst match with clear gaps, one adjacent reporting role, one keyword-stuffed data-entry trap, one marginal analytics-engineering role, and four distractors.
rationale: j3 is the keyword trap: a BPO Data Entry Specialist posting stuffed with the resume's exact tokens (SQL, Excel, Tableau, pivot tables, VLOOKUP) while the actual work is manual transcription and physical filing — a completely different job family, so grade 0; TF-IDF will over-rank it and the hybrid matcher should not. j2 is a grade-2 same-family reporting role whose BI tool is Power BI rather than Tableau, testing that near-synonym stacks still rank well. j4 probes the graded boundary: genuine expert-SQL overlap, but the core stack (dbt, Snowflake, Airflow) is absent from the resume, so grade 1. Gap target j1 is a same-family Data Analyst role with unambiguous annotated gaps (Python/pandas required and absent; Snowflake required but partially covered by PostgreSQL SQL experience; dbt and Looker preferred) plus heavy overlap on SQL/Tableau/Excel that justifies grade 3 and feeds must_not_claim.

jobs.raw_text:
Data Analyst — Cobalt Wave Outdoor (Remote, US)

Cobalt Wave sells outdoor gear through 60 retail partners and a fast-growing DTC site. Our analytics team is hiring a Data Analyst to own merchandising and sales reporting.

What you will do:
- Build and maintain Tableau dashboards for merchandising, sales, and inventory teams
- Write SQL against our Snowflake warehouse to answer ad-hoc business questions
- Clean and validate messy retail-partner data before it reaches reporting
- Present weekly findings to non-technical stakeholders

Requirements: SQL, Tableau, advanced Microsoft Excel (Power Query, pivot tables), Python (pandas), Snowflake. 1-3 years in a data or reporting analyst role plus experience presenting to non-technical stakeholders. Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or analytical field.

Nice to have: dbt, Looker, experience analyzing A/B tests.

Reporting Analyst — MidState Health Partners (Hybrid, Columbus OH)

MidState operates 14 outpatient clinics across Ohio. We need a Reporting Analyst to keep our operational reporting accurate and on time.

You will build Power BI reports for clinic operations, write SQL against our SQL Server data mart, maintain the Excel-based monthly close workbooks, and document reporting logic for auditors.

Requirements: SQL, Power BI, strong Excel (pivot tables, XLOOKUP), careful documentation habits. 1-2 years of reporting or analytics experience. Bachelor's degree preferred.

Bonus: Tableau, prior healthcare reporting experience.

jobs.raw_text:
Data Entry Specialist — CoreProcess BPO Services (Onsite, Tulsa OK)

CoreProcess handles back-office processing for insurance and logistics clients. We are hiring Data Entry Specialists for our night shift. Our client documents are full of terms like SQL, Excel, and Tableau — you will see them everywhere.

You will transcribe scanned invoices into Excel templates at 10,000+ keystrokes per hour, paste records exported from client SQL databases into web portals, and print, sort, and physically file Tableau dashboard reports for archiving. No analysis is performed in this role.

Requirements: fast and accurate typing, Microsoft Excel data entry (files may contain pivot tables and VLOOKUP formulas built by others), copying records exported from SQL databases, filing printed Tableau reports. High school diploma. Bonus: prior BPO or claims-processing experience.
